purpose: Document official local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official Ekiti State sources document land administration and cadastral survey responsibilities, an e-GIS center/LMIS, and survey work in Ado Ekiti. The online title route is account- and document-based; state mapping statements do not prove published parcel vectors. No public map-service endpoint, schema or exact-point geometry was verified.
registryAssessment: Ekiti State Government identifies a Bureau of Land Services and Office of Surveyor-General with cadastral surveys and survey-plan approval, plus an Ekiti State Geospatial Data Center and automated land-management information system. Statewide aerial mapping was launched from Ado Ekiti and the government budget lists cadastral survey work for Ado Ekiti. Online title workflows require a registered account, approved survey plan and supporting documents; no anonymous parcel geometry service was found.
